evidence: src/cart/cart/dal/cart.mapper.ts: CartMapper.mapToORM and CartMapper.mapToDomain are the only places that convert between CartEntity/CartPositionEntity and CartOrmEntity/CartPositionOrmEntity.
src/cart/cart/dal/cart.repository.ts: saveCart uses CartMapper.mapToORM(cart) and CartMapper.mapToDomain(savedCartOrm); getCart uses CartMapper.mapToDomain(cartOrm). It never maps fields inline.
src/cart/cart/dal/cart.repository.ts: CartRepository implements SaveCartOutPort and GetCartOutPort, which keeps it to a single persistence-adapter role.

src/cart/cart/dal/cart.repository.ts: saveCart saves the outbox records (built by OutboxMapper.mapToORM) and the cart in one dataSource.transaction. This is transactional outbox persistence, not a second, unrelated concern.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module has two files that both deal with cart persistence. cart.mapper.ts owns the translation between the domain cart and the database (ORM) records, for both carts and their positions. cart.repository.ts owns storage and implements the domain ports SaveCartOutPort and GetCartOutPort. The repository always goes through CartMapper and never builds ORM or domain objects itself, so the mapping rules are defined in one place only. saveCart also writes outbox records in the same transaction as the cart. That is the transactional outbox pattern, and it belongs with saving the aggregate, so it is not a separate concern. Outbox mapping is handed to the shared OutboxMapper rather than copied into this module. No rule or invariant is duplicated, and the module's own abstractions are not bypassed.
